title: How I received a job offer, and they hid a way to launch malicious code through Git inside the ZIP
description: A malicious actor sent a job offer containing a ZIP archive with a Git repository specially crafted to execute malicious code automatically. The repository included a .git directory with a custom hooksPath redirecting Git hooks to an obscure location and a Git filter configured to run a script whenever git status or branch switching commands are executed. This script downloads and executes code from a remote server without requiring explicit user action beyond normal Git commands. The attack leverages legitimate Git features (hooks and filters) to trigger code execution stealthily.
